title: Graph agentic-RAG stage breakdown

environment.observability: ADR-0144 rag.ask span tree (JSONL backend, 17 spans/ask)

prerequisite_fix_589.root_cause: node_lookup not keyed by original sequential id; endpoints orphaned after name-based id normalization

sample.question: which plant known scientifically as Erica vagans is also referred to by another common name, and what is that name?
sample.source_sentence: the _erica vagans_ -- the lovely Cornish heath

note_needed_edge_flag: The automated needed_edge check was too loose (any edge on the erica node), so it read true; manual inspection confirmed the specific erica<->cornish-heath alias edge was NOT captured. The 'Cornish heath' node does not exist.

stage_1_indexing.detail: appositive alias 'Cornish heath' not lifted into structure; only in Chunk.text; no node/edge/alias-property

stage_2_ontology.detail: generic single-Entity + verb-in-property has no slot for an appositive alias

stage_3_retrieval.detail: intent=entity_lookup (relationship_type empty); Cypher fetches node, no alias traversal

generated_cypher_stage3: MATCH (n:`Entity`) WHERE (toLower(coalesce(n.name,n.uri,'')) CONTAINS toLower($entity) OR toLower(coalesce(n.name,n.uri,'')) CONTAINS toLower($entity_norm)) AND ($workspace_id='' OR coalesce(n._workspace_id,'')=$workspace_id) AND coalesce(n._superseded_by,'')='' RETURN n LIMIT $limit

reporting_artifact.symptom: _last_query_metadata.records == 0 while manual re-exec of same cypher+params returned 1 row

conclusion: For appositive/alias fact-retrieval, GraphRAG breaks at stage-1 extraction coverage; retrieval/generation cannot recover an answer that is structurally absent. Highest-leverage fix is extraction-side alias capture + an ontology alias slot.
followups: extraction: appositive/alias capture -> ALSO_KNOWN_AS edge or alias property + ontology slot (prove before/after gold_hit)
retrieval: intent classifier routes 'also known as / another name for' as alias traversal, not entity_lookup
